a.text: I see gravel kicked up by tires, pounding the glass.
Similar sights keep retreating from the car window: muddy earth, dried bloodstains, shell craters we carefully steer around... War flows persistently, like an oil slick set alight.
The atmosphere outside the car is tense. Everyone remains silent. The driver is focused on driving, Paprika sits beside her, occasionally turning her head to cast a worried glance.
In the cab, the Miner casually oils his weapon, the Shopkeep from Kazdel mimics him. He cries out suddenly, looks like he cut his palm.

Kazdel has grocery stores, children gazing longingly at candy as they lean against the counter, old folks complaining about the changing price of salt. It makes sense, but... I never really thought about those sights before.
For me, Kazdel is just a distant memory. When I was little, Babel briefly stopped near Kazdel.
I only remember it from a distance, a sight like a steel monster crawling through the wastes, leaving debris and thick smoke in its wake. Theresa held my hand and told me that was her home.
I remember... at the time, I didn't know what the look on her face meant.

Much later, I talked to the operators about Kazdel. Mudrock called it a barren land of houses stacked on top of each other, Stormeye talked about an eternal furnace and crystal clusters on the city walls.
W... she laughed an icy laugh and said: 'If I were a bunny like you, I'd steer clear of the place.'
Kazdel feels like a vague symbol, representing all kinds of things: pain, hatred, oppression, slaughter... I know these are all true, objectively, but they're not everything that is Kazdel.
Setting all that aside, I know it's the place where Theresa sacrificed everything.
Even Theresis, the mastermind behind this war, grew up there. What does the Kazdel they envision look like?
Logos quietly wipes his bone pen. On the other side, I see the Doctor turning to look out the window. What's out there?
I tug on the Doctor's sleeve.

options: Dr. {@nickname}, when the war is over, I want to visit Kazdel again.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Stop the car. There's something strange up ahead.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: All units, prepare for battle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is that—

a.text: In the distance, the town of Brentwood is already coming into view.
A crimson light rises from the center of the town, staining the surrounding land.
The blood-covered veil gently envelops all living things.

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: Hngh—!

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: —This feeling, it's the same one that came when we were inspecting those Arts Circles.

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: Banshee, Your Lordship, what is this...?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: When the war started, no one expected the land to be drenched in so much blood so quickly.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Modern warfare' is it? Hah.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm afraid the Vampire has all the prerequisites he needs for the ritual to fall into place.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The crystals on the other battlefields were just nodes resonating with the ritual. All this time, I've been looking for its center.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Brentwood, this little town, has a special place in the Vampire's wicked design.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can you handle it, Logos?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This is an ancient Royal Court method, and they have completed the preparations for it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I need time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We haven't exposed our position yet, so we might be able to buy some time, but... Wait—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Fire?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's a firefight in the town there... but who is it?
Looks like they beat us here.
A rather choppy meeting.

a.text: The Doctor looks calm.
Right, after all we've been through, we finally get to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with our friends again.

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: Lord Banshee, what... are you going to do? You'll take care of the enemy, won't you?

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: This, this power... it's a blessing from His Highness the Prince of Blood, is it?

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: The Sanguinarch... he's blessed the Sarkaz bloodline.

a.text: The Ursine miner swings his weapon and a sharp whistling sound rings out.
He looks a little frightened of his own strike, almost losing his grip on the weapon.
The driver and the Shopkeep gather around him, investigating his new strength.
Paprika moves a few steps toward me.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Um... Lord Banshee, I also feel a bit... stronger... a little.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Is it arm strength? Or my brains? I can't tell for sure, but I just feel kinda...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's a strengthening altar, witchcraft. We've seen this before. But this one is on a larger scale, and it feels different.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Logos, could this have any adverse...?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Quite unexpected.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It does not demand a price of us, at least not one drawn from our own bodies.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Then why—

a.text: Logos looks at the Sarkaz girl.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Paprika, was it?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: What do you hope to use this power for?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Well...
The more skilled a Sarkaz becomes in war, the more efficient he spills blood on the battlefield. Doesn't matter if it's his enemies' blood or his own.
The ritual can continue.
The Sanguinarch has prepared for this decisive battle, but their... Theresis's plan was just for this ritual?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The Arts Circles seem to have come under attack, and the Vampiric creatures are going out of control.

a.text: Yes, a large colony of crimson worms is drilling out of the ground, rushing around in all directions.
A good number of them seem to have caught our scent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Leave this to us, Logos.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please look into the ritual for us.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, you and the Doctor could accompany me.

a.text: I look at Paprika's team in the distance, those Sarkaz unaware of the danger here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's be quick.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Roger.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Um—

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What are you going to do with us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I realized a while ago that, well, the ones who've been captured... are us, right?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I know the Royal Court guys pretty well, and you give off a totally different vibe.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Your name is Amiya, right? You and this Doctor are in charge.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I think... you're about the same age as me.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: And I can tell that Banshee is a pretty big deal, I can feel it, you can't fake that. But he's working for you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: A few days ago, I met a Caprinae lady who called herself a Sarkaz... is she with you too?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Just who the heck are you guys?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you intend to fight us, Paprika?

a.text: I can feel that the girl is not hostile.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... don't know.

a.text: In the distance, the Sarkaz let go of the sudden surge of power they're feeling for a moment, and call out to Paprika.

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Captain, how did the Banshee get away? What do we do now? The cracks in the earth are spreading toward us!

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: Why did they leave those two prisoners behind? Do the big shots from the Royal Court trust us so much?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Um... yeah! Be on guard for threats from that direction!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'll keep an eye on these two!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You may be stronger, but you still don't know war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Or I guess, none of you are ready to fight this war.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: ...Yeah. After all this time, how could we not know?

a.text: I get a little closer to her.
But she seems to misunderstand my intent, and retreats half a step. Then, as if making a difficult decision, she holds her ground in front of me.
And at this point, I realize she's about the same height as I am.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm the captain of the transport team! If you're going to do something to us, you have to start with me.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: They're just regular people who answered His Highness's call to arms across Terra.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: They don't even know what they're doing. They just transport the stuff General Manfred says to move—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The instant they answered that call... the Victorians would cease to call them regular people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that's got nothing to do with what they've actually done.

a.text: I think of the fires in Auchterigg, the factory pipes in Sudean, the street corners of Norport...
The survival of the Sarkaz means the destruction of Victoria.
The triumph of Victoria means the cleansing of the Sarkaz.
Those caught in the vortex no longer have the power to choose.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: They're units put under my control by the General. No matter what happens, I have to guarantee their safety.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I swore as much to General Manfred.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The General, huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then first thing's first, let's deal with these out-of-control blood worms together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Tell your team to fall back. Don't take any chances, these creatures will suck dry any blood they can find.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, stick close to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will use my power to clear the way for us, and for them.

a.text: The fractured, surging land spreads out before us.
The Vampiric offspring bathe in blood, indulging in the pain. Their bite is the touch of the Sanguinarch himself.
I raise my hand and close my eyes. I will stitch together this scarred land.
I will hold the whispered fate of the myriad souls in my hands.
A black rhombus, a black shadow.
Black Arts surge from my fingertips.
These twisted offspring deserve peace.

steps.text: Hey little bunny, there's a faster way to seal those cracks, you know?

steps.name: W
steps.text: 'Bang, bang, bang!'

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: It-It's...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Sarkaz mercenaries?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Watch your footing, Yarnball, that's not a great place to stand.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Huh—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: My advice is to give that lunatic a wide berth when she's tossing bombs around. W's not the type a sweet little Sarkaz baby oughta be close to.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Oh, Ines?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Thanks, and, err, Ami—

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Wait, over your head there, that's...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: The Black Crown? You're the one General Manfred was talking about...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I heard Manfred picked up a kid, guess that was you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: These Sarkaz are under my control. You're their captain, right?

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: Hey, let go of me! Who... who are you? What do you want?

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: We're on a mission for the Military Commission and all the big shots from the Royal Court!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Great, I'm here to enforce their discipline.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Hey there, Amiya. And, of course...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hoederer...

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's wrong, your first face-to-face meeting got you feeling disappointed?

steps.name: W
steps.text: He did spend more time playing the antagonist than working our side. I'm not used to it either.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you for your help, Hoederer. We can talk about the other stuff later.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As you can see, this little town is quickly becoming a war zone.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah, I do see. And we've got some important intel to share with you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: About this town and the 'Lifeline' hidden in its shadows.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: There are two forces attacking the town's Sarkaz garrison. One is the Self-Salvation Corps that Closure brought out from Londinium.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmph, looks like my safehouse got trashed. I hope that old hag doesn't go peacefully.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The other is a force made up of soldiers who once fought for different dukes... along with some workers and refugees.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It's a pretty disorganized group, led by—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The Siege.

a.text: We reach the town to find the battle has mostly subsided.
Logos has not yet returned from the town center. Seems dealing with the Vampiric ritual is no simple task.
I catch sight of Siege and Delphine, as well as Misery and Closure, along with fighters from the Self-Salvation Corps
When we left Londinium, we never expected this rendezvous in Brentwood would be so... difficult for each of us.
We make our way to a dilapidated house, but the atmosphere isn't the kind of exhaustion and relief you'd expect from a long-awaited reunion with friends.
After giving me a quick physical, Dr. Kal'tsit and the Doctor take some crystal samples and move to talk privately.
The room falls silent, and all eyes turn to Hoederer, leaning against the wall alone.
The rhythm of his sword sharpening is as steady as his breathing.
Delphine recognizes Hoederer with a glance.
General Manfred of the Kazdel Military Commission's right hand man. He was involved in the execution and assassination of many political figures throughout Londinium.
Then, Hoederer tells us about a Feranmut brought to Londinium by the Sarkaz.

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Urk—Help—Hngh—

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: Shh!

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: Quiet down, *Sarkaz profanity*.

a.text: We all turn to the Sarkaz who have not yet figured out the situation.

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Where are we...?

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Victorians?! And... Sarkaz mercenaries?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: It's okay, I'm still here.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: The situation is, um, a little bit complicated. But you can trust me on this.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You aren't actually gonna carry this dead weight around for the next phase of the plan, are you?

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Who are you calling dead weight?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W, I promised Paprika that no harm would come to them.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh, Rhodes Island, same as it ever was.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Then let's have them stick with my mercs. They've had it too easy for too long, might as well bring some new blood in to have some fun.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey you, blue-haired Feline, what's on your mind? You've been staring at us for a while.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Feel like killing us? Go ahead, draw your sword.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not gonna do it? Pfft.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If all you want is a Bolívarian standoff, I'm gonna pass. Me and my men oughta hit the road.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You can stay here and stay mad.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, by the way, Ines, if you're gonna fight the Victorians, make sure you let me know ahead of time. Wouldn't wanna miss the show.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lady Delphine...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You're alright. I'm glad. I was worried.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I... Amiya, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'm willing to trust Rhodes Island's processes in choosing collaboration partners.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's just... I mean... I'm an intelligence officer myself. It's not as if I've never heard of this 'Hoederer' gentleman.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I just... No, it's not just him, even Misery, and Ines, I can't help but think...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I can't accept it, not at the moment.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...No, maybe I can't ever accept it.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But for now, as I said, I'll trust Vina's judgment.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If this is what we have to do, then let's do it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: These scars won't be forgotten, nor should they be.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Sarkaz Wars have never ended, Feline.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Cut the Military Commission's supply lines, indeed, this has been our goal all along.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: In any case, this is a way to end the war quickly.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And as for this 'Feranmut'...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I know what you're thinking.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now that no base is safe, this skeleton can become our key to counterattacking Londinium.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can't take any of these armies head-on, and we can't work around the essentially unbeatable firepower of that airship...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So, this 'elusive' Feranmut is the best vehicle we could hope for. And, at the same time, it's a fortress, and a spear aimed right at the heart.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: In that case, if we succeed, it'll be thanks to the leaders of this counterattack, and not... 'Sarkaz mercenaries'.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It seems we have no grounds on which to refuse cooperation.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'However...'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: From a rational point of view, I understand that there are differences among the Sarkaz, that the Exemplars appears to function seamlessly with Misery, but... we're talking about individual friendship.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We may be able to respect, trust, and even love a few select individuals. But now, we stand before a war where all sides have blood-soaked hands.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Given enough time, we may be able to determine one-by-one who has committed war crimes and who is innocent, but we do not have that time.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We are at an impasse, Hoederer. Our cooperation will not be so smooth.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that is why we are here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island will serve as a mediator between the two parties.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Such that we can end the suffering of the Victorian people that this war has wrought, and such that we can prevent the Sarkaz of Kazdel from being dragged back into the abyss.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're not here to force handshakes and reconciliation, we can leave that to the end of this ridiculous war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Platitudes mean nothing. It's actions that will put an end to all this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is all very Rhodes Island, indeed... I've heard Hoederer has been in contact with Rhodes Island in the past?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You've mentioned the place where the Feranmut is docked, among a large number of Sarkaz garrisons.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But if we're talking about the plan rationally, a small number of elites would do better than...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Better than sending workers and street thugs to their deaths, yes? You can speak openly, I won't mind.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But my boys won't miss a chance to strike at the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Our armor can draw the garrison's fire.

a.text: I see Hoederer smiling. It seems this is a side of Siege that relaxes him, at least a bit.
After all, he seems to be hiding something.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That'll do, thanks.

a.text: Hoederer expresses his gratitude and the discussion comes to a close.
Sarkaz mercenary, Hoederer.
After reuniting with W in Chernobog, Ascalon gave me his complete file. It dates back to the time of... Babel.
So, I trust him.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Amiya.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This is our first formal cooperation with Rhodes Island.

spans.text: This is our first formal cooperation with

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, it is.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, if I might ask you a question...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You didn't express your worries or concerns just now. Your innermost thoughts...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are to save lives, to put an end to war and hate. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've heard that the King of Sarkaz can see into people's hearts. It's different from the ambiguous feeling Ines gets. I probably can't hide it from you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can respect a Sarkaz who has struggled since the Babel days.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope you can answer from your own free will.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So that's how it is.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm... fighting for that future.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you for your answer, and your trust.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Logos, Dr. Kal'tsit, you're back!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I've analyzed the Vampiric ritual. The results are worrying.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It is indeed a blood blessing, using ancient and very fine techniques.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The Sanguinarch borrows the witchcraft's power, collecting blood spilled in the war to activate the bloodline within the Sarkaz warriors.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He is giving the Sarkaz a constant reminder of our fundamental differences with the other races. It's less amplification and more incitement.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But most importantly... I'm afraid he's using only a small part of the power he's collected for this purpose.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: More energy is going somewhere else, somewhere I don't know. I tried to track it, but the structure of the Arts is complex and chaotic. It only points to Londinium.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What is he playing at?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: And that reminded me...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: At this very moment, at the center of the battlefield stands a Sarkaz leader even better at absorbing and exploiting death than the Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: If it was really just about strengthening the warriors, why would they bother using the witchcraft of the Crimson Court? And why use an Arts Circle? Such that even the towns on the edge of this war get roped in?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Do you have a theory?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The airship, the Feranmut, The Shard, and the witchcraft device right here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Doctor's concerns are justified.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As you said, the Feranmut will be our most important breakthrough, and we must take action as soon as possible.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether Vampire or Nachzehrer, even the Confessarii, they are all exposed to Nightingale in a most unusual way, they are taking risks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There is a reason why the war is being fought at this particular point in time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Theresis is preparing his final trump card in Londinium. Sure, seizing the capital of an empire is already unheard of...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, what could it be?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let me start with a fundamental question.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A question so fundamental that even the Sarkaz have forgotten it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Why are the Sarkaz so uniquely susceptible to Oripathy?'
